Status: Sick: Hugo, Mira, Una, Finn, Greta, Vik, Jonah, Ada, Pia, Suri. Slow lifts: east wing, harbour, loading bay. Umbrellas: east wing, library annex, garden studio. Coffee machines: loading bay, garden studio (working), north office (fixed), east wing, harbour.

Updates: Print room repainting (afternoon noise). East wing repainting (morning noise). Jonah wants east wing clear for visitors. Leon, Dell, Rafe involved.

Pending: Send notes to Bram, Cora, Hugo, Una, Ada. Check with Opal before evening meeting. Remind about Greta’s preference. Check with Suri before morning meeting. Check with Esme before morning meeting.

Coverage: Kira covers Mira; Cora covers Suri.
